meta.title: About MAES17 — Geodesy and land surveying by {{owner}}
meta.description: MAES17 is a professional team of geodesy and land surveying specialists with more than {{years}} years of experience, led by {{owner}}, individual entrepreneur. Checked results and clear documentation.

hero.title: Measurement you can build on.
hero.lede: MAES17 is a professional team in geodesy, land surveying and land development with more than {{years}} years of experience. We turn land and structures into reliable coordinates, plans and documents.
hero.imageAlt: Shaded relief of mountain ridges at dusk with faint contour lines

overview.title: Who we are
paragraphs: MAES17 is operated by {{owner}}, individual entrepreneur, together with a professional team of surveying and land management specialists with more than {{years}} years of experience. The team covers the full chain of survey work: establishing control, measuring in the field, processing observations and preparing the plans and files that clients need.
Clients include private landowners, designers, builders and organisations that need dependable spatial information before they buy, design, build or register.

mission.title: Mission
mission.text: To give every client measurements they can rely on, explained in terms they can act on.

vision.title: Vision
vision.text: A practice known for careful fieldwork, transparent methods and documentation that remains useful long after the project ends.

items.title: Accuracy is verified, not assumed
items.text: Measurements are checked against control and redundancy before results are issued.

items.title: Method follows purpose
items.text: A boundary question, a design survey and a construction layout each need different tolerances and outputs.

items.title: Transparency
items.text: Scope, methods, limitations and deliverables are stated clearly in advance.

items.title: Responsibility
items.text: Every project has a responsible lead you can reach directly.

team.title: Expertise
team.text: {{owner}} leads a professional team of specialists in geodesy, surveying and land management with more than {{years}} years of experience. The team carries out the fieldwork, data processing and documentation for every project.

methodology.title: Working methodology
methodology.lede: Each project follows the same documented sequence, from the first conversation to final delivery.
methodology.link: See the full process on the home page

technology.title: Equipment and technology
technology.text: Work combines satellite positioning, total station measurement and digital processing in CAD and GIS software. The instruments used and the achievable accuracy are stated in the proposal for each project.
technology.imageAlt: Yellow robotic total station on a tripod at a road construction site

quality.title: Quality assurance
items: Measurements tie to defined control points and a stated coordinate system.
Independent checks and closures are used to detect errors before drafting.
Deliverables list the methods, date of survey and coordinate system used.
Raw and processed data are archived so results can be traced later.

cta.title: Have a site in mind?
cta.text: A short call is usually enough to define what needs to be measured.
